Authenticate like any other `/api/v1` route (typically an `sk_` key).\n- [Revoke a model lease](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-refere
nce/eval-runs/revoke-a-model-lease.md): Kills this caller's SDK model leases under `runId` in the addressed project, immediately:
the proxy fails a revoked lease closed from that moment. Leases also expire on their own, so this is for ending a run early (an SD
K suite calls it at teardown) rather than something a caller must do.\n- [Close an open ingestion run](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api
-reference/eval-runs/close-an-open-ingestion-run.md): Marks the run complete and computes its rollups. Until this is called the ru
n stays open in the dashboard.\n- [Append iterations to an open run](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/eval-runs/append-iterat
ions-to-an-open-run.md): Appends one batch of iteration results to a run opened by `runs/start`.\n- [Authenticate and record an ev
al start](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/eval-runs/authenticate-and-record-an-eval-start.md): Called by official SDK, CLI a
nd Vitest runners before executing an eval. Requires an organization API key or saved-login bearer. Records only start metadata, c
reates no dashboard run, and applies no debit or quota draw. Planned iterations are intent, not completed usage. Reuse the runStar
tId for ret…\n- [Open a run for incremental ingestion](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/eval-runs/open-a-run-for-incremental-
ingestion.md): Opens a run that iterations are appended to, for a long CI job that reports as it goes. Pair with `runs/iterations`
and `runs/finalize`.\n- [Get a run's gate waiver](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/eval-runs/get-a-runs-gate-waiver.md): The
waiver in force over this run, or `null`. Available to anyone who can VIEW the run, not only to those who can grant one: a waiver
its readers cannot see is not a visible waiver.\n- [Waive a run gate](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/eval-runs/waive-a-run
-gate.md): Override a FAILING run's release gate until an expiry you name. This does NOT make the run pass: the run keeps its `res
ult`, the waiver is a separate audited record, and every surface that honors it, such as the CLI's `eval gate`, reports the gate a
s waived, by whom, why, and until when.\n- [Revoke a gate waiver](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/eval-runs/revoke-a-gate-wa
iver.md): End a waiver early, putting the gate back. Requires the manage tier.\n- [Preview deterministic draft evaluators against
stored evidence](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/eval-runs/preview-deterministic-draft-evaluators-against-stored-evidence.md
): Requires suite configuration permission and a terminal run. Reserves a 60-second deterministic-preview cooldown, independent of
judge previews. Supply the returned continuation object with the unchanged draft to read the next bounded population. Reads at mo
st 100 iterations within a 30-second operat…\n- [Get the host-compat catalog](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/catalog/get-th
e-host-compat-catalog.md): The versioned host-compatibility catalog backing `mcpjam compat` verdicts. Public and unauthenticated:
static host facts and creation config with no project or user scope. Always returns a catalog: `source` is `live` when the publish
ed catalog was reachable and `bundled` when serving the SDK's built…\n- [Get the authenticated account](https://docs.mcpjam.com/ap
i-reference/catalog/get-the-authenticated-account.md): The user behind the API key (keys act as their creator, scoped to one organ
ization).\n- [Read the organization's spend budget](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/catalog/read-the-organizations-spend-bud
get.md): The ceiling on what this organization may spend on MCPJam-billed work (chat, evals, judges and computer time) in the curr
ent billing window, and how much of it has been spent.\n- [Set the organization's spend budget](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-refere
nce/catalog/set-the-organizations-spend-budget.md): Set or replace the ceiling. **Requires organization owner or admin.**\n- [Remo
ve the organization's spend budget](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/catalog/remove-the-organizations-spend-budget.md): Leave
the organization uncapped. **Requires organization owner or admin.**\n- [List organizations](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-referenc
e/catalog/list-organizations.md): The organizations the caller belongs to: the source of the `organizationId` that `GET /projects`
filters by and `POST /projects` accepts. An API key is bound to one organization and only ever sees that one. Read-only: organiza
tion, member, role and billing changes are not part of the public API.\n- [List projects](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/ca
talog/list-projects.md): Projects the caller can access. API keys only ever see projects inside the key's organization.\n- [List a
project's servers](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/catalog/list-a-projects-servers.md): The MCP servers saved in the projec
t: the `serverId`s every other route takes. STDIO command/args/env and raw headers are never exposed.\n- [List a project's eval su
ites](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/catalog/list-a-projects-eval-suites.md): Eval suites in the project with latest-run su
mmaries and pass-rate trends: the `suiteId`s the eval-run routes take.\n- [List chat sessions](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-referen
ce/catalog/list-chat-sessions.md): Chat sessions visible to the caller (personal + project-shared merged). Top-level rather than p
roject-nested because `projectId` is an optional filter, not an owning scope.\n- [The MCPJam-provided model catalog](https://docs.
mcpjam.com/api-reference/catalog/the-mcpjam-provided-model-catalog.md): PUBLIC: this route carries no user or project data and req
uires no bearer token.\n- [Export project traces as OTLP/JSON](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/catalog/export-project-traces
-as-otlpjson.md): Returns an OTLP `ExportTraceServiceRequest`. Pagination rides in RESPONSE HEADERS rather than the body so the pa
yload stays a valid OTLP document: read `x-mcpjam-next-cursor` and feed it back as `cursor`, and treat `x-mcpjam-export-complete:
true` as the end of the stream.\n- [List a project's clients](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/clients/list-a-projects-client
s.md): The clients saved in the project: the named, reusable configurations that define how MCPJam connects to and talks to your M
CP servers. Returns the `id`s and `configId`s the detail and write routes take. Clients that exist only as the private backing of
a User Testing study are omitted unless `includ…\n- [Create a client (from a template or a full config)](https://docs.mcpjam.com/a
pi-reference/clients/create-a-client-from-a-template-or-a-full-config.md): Creates a client in the project and responds `201` with
the new client's detail. Seed the config one of two ways: pass `template` (a built-in template id, optional `theme`) to seed serv
er-side from the live client-template catalog, falling back to the bundled SDK catalog snapshot if the live catalog…\n- [Get a cli
ent](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/clients/get-a-client.md): One client's full settings, including its resolved config, it
s `configId` (the concurrency token every write takes), and `impact`: what a config edit would follow. The path segment accepts a
client **name or ID**. A client that exists but belongs to a different project reads as `404 NOT_FOUND`.\n- [Delete a client](http
s://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/clients/delete-a-client.md): Permanently deletes the client. Refused while a live environment, a
n active legacy goal or an eval suite still holds it: the error names what to detach first. Guest callers are denied (a write).\n-
[Update a client](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/clients/update-a-client.md): Edit a client's display name and/or its conf
ig. Two ways to change the config: `config` replaces it wholesale, and `set` changes named fields over the config read inside the
write transaction. Prefer `set`, because a whole-config round-trip composed from a stale read reverts whatever landed in betwe…\n-
